name: Trade Settlement 2
definition: Trade settlement details for this invoice which involves the payment of an outstanding debt, account, or charge.

DueDate.name: Due Date
DueDate.definition: Date when invoice should be paid.

InvoiceCurrencyExchange.name: Invoice Currency Exchange
InvoiceCurrencyExchange.definition: If invoice currency is different from local tax reporting currency, then applied exchange rate is given in this message structure.

DeliveryDate.name: Delivery Date
DeliveryDate.definition: Date when goods/services are delivered to buyer.

BillingPeriod.name: Billing Period
BillingPeriod.definition: Period during which delivery executed or agreed invoicing period.

TaxTotalAmount.name: Tax Total Amount
TaxTotalAmount.definition: Tax total amount with currency code.

ExemptionReasonCode.name: Exemption Reason Code
ExemptionReasonCode.definition: Reason for tax exemption expressed as a code, if invoice or card transaction is out of tax processing.

ExemptionReason.name: Exemption Reason
ExemptionReason.definition: Reason for a tax exemption, if invoice or card transaction is out of tax processing.

EarlyPayments.name: Early Payments
EarlyPayments.definition: Details of each early payment discount.
